capabilities: show excerpts of incoming links at the bottom of notes
customize excerpt length and display settings
extras: Originally created by @jensmtg, now maintained by @jensmtg's successor @semanticdata; the manifest description calls it a bullet journaling plugin while the README focuses on contextual backlinks.
intentEvidence: Transform your Obsidian backlinks from simple links into rich context.
problem: Core backlinks only show link titles, so you can't see the surrounding content of a link without opening the notes.

relations.evidence: I much prefer Influx over the core Backlinks plugin

summary: Backlinks enhancer that shows contextual excerpts from linked notes in a stream at the bottom of each note.
